decisions.reason: Define-XML ADAE.AOCC01FL and ADRG page-8 select the first treatment-emergent dermatologic event by ASTDT then AESEQ, and probe lines 48-59 and 122-129 apply the ADTTE.ADT strict-after-TRTSDT test to it with the converted RFENDTC fallback. In each of the five differing records the selected ASTDT falls on TRTSDT and the reference keeps it, which only the inclusive ADAE.TRTEMFL condition (ASTDT >= TRTSDT) admits, as ADT__TREATMENT_EMERGENT reproduces.

Define-XML ADTTE.STARTDT (workbook Methods row 144) names ADSL.RFSTDTC, but adtte_v1.yaml line 166 reads ADSL.TRTSDT, which the Pilot 5 adsl.yaml lines 343-357 derive from MIN(EX.EXSTDTC) and Define-XML ADSL.TRTSDT documents from SV.SVSTDTC. The specification never routes STARTDT through RFSTDTC, so equal values on this data do not make TRTSDT the documented source.

Define-XML ADTTE.ADT requires ADAE.ASTDT to be nonmissing and strictly after TRTSDT, but adtte_v1.yaml HAS_EVENT (lines 168-175) tests only that a FIRST_DERM record exists under the AOCC01FL filter at line 69. Define-XML ADAE.AOCC01FL and ADAE.TRTEMFL make that flag inclusive (ASTDT >= TRTSDT), and no other element of the composed specification states the strict comparison, so a same-day event is accepted.
